notes: 'the rulers also' takes its 'also' from the waw of וְהָרֹעִים under rule 51; distance from the waw is not evidence against it.
s030 gives the supplied antecedent and relative of 'things that do not profit' to the verb's own unit, since no article or אֲשֶׁר morpheme is present to take them (rule 46's reasoning).
